name: ORCA
description: ORCA is a publicly available benchmark for Arabic language understanding evaluation, covering diverse Arabic varieties and a wide range of challenging tasks across 60 datasets and seven NLU task clusters.
reputation: ORCA is a notable Arabic NLU benchmark that has been used as a broad evaluation suite for Arabic language models across many tasks and dialects.
notes: Includes a public leaderboard and comprehensive comparison of 18 multilingual and Arabic language models.
